meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理消息通道与智能体组的连接：查看当前连接状态、把新聊天通道接到某个小组、调整隔离级别，或重新配置现有连接。
howto.when: 当你添加了新聊天通道后、在初始设置期间，或单独要求重新配置通道连接时触发。

say.text: 查看当前所有通道和智能体组的连接状态。
say.note: Claude 会先检查配置并展示摘要。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Telegram 群接到我的工作小组。
say.note: Claude 会询问隔离级别并完成连接。

say.text: 把 Slack 的某个频道改接到另一个智能体组。
say.note: Claude 会确认旧连接并更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage connections between messaging channels and agent groups: inspect current state, wire a new channel to a group, adjust isolation, or reconfigure existing wiring.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you add a new channel, during initial setup, or when you ask to reconfigure channel wiring.

say_en.text: Show current connection status of all channels and agent groups.
say_en.note: Claude checks the config and displays a summary.

say_en.text: Connect this Telegram group to my work group.
say_en.note: Claude asks about isolation and completes the wiring.

say_en.text: Move a Slack channel to another agent group.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the old wiring and updates it.
